h1: Wasi Café: a specialty coffee shop in San Isidro, Lima, with menu, prices and hours
ogTitulo: Wasi Café, specialty coffee in San Isidro, Lima
descripcion: Specialty Peruvian coffee, breakfast, brunch and lunch in San Isidro, Lima: Wasi Café menu with prices, opening hours, payments and WiFi.
intro:
If you are staying or working in San Isidro, Lima's business district, and want good coffee without a long taxi ride, Wasi Café is a specialty coffee shop on Luis Felipe Villarán 904, a short walk from Javier Prado Avenue. Wasi means «house» in Quechua. This guide has everything a visitor needs: hours, what to order, prices and how to pay.

All prices are in Peruvian soles (S/) and come from our online menu, which is also available in English and updates automatically from our register.

secciones.html:
We are open Monday to Friday from 8:00 a.m. to 9:00 p.m. and Saturday from 9:00 a.m. to 9:00 p.m.; closed on Sundays. We don't close at midday, so you can come for breakfast and stay through lunch.

According to our sales, the busiest times are 1 to 2 p.m. (lunch) and 5 to 8 p.m.; mornings from 9 to 12 are the quietest, which makes them a good time to work or read.

All our coffee is 100% Peruvian specialty coffee from Cusco, Cajamarca, Junín, Amazonas and San Martín. Some prices from the bar:

  • Espresso (S/ 9.00) and Americano (S/ 9.00). The Americano is by far our most served coffee.
  • Cortado (S/ 9.00), Cappuccino (S/ 12.00) and Latte, «café con leche» (S/ 11.00).
  • Filter coffee (S/ 8.00).
  • Iced coffee (S/ 14.90), iced latte (S/ 15.90) and frappés from S/ 15.90.

If you've never tried Peruvian coffee, start with an espresso or a filter coffee to taste the bean on its own.

Cappuccino at Wasi Café, San Isidro, Lima

secciones.html:
Breakfast combos all include coffee, and several add a fresh papaya or pineapple juice:

  • Continental (S/ 19.90): coffee, juice, toast, jam and butter.
  • American breakfast (S/ 23.90): coffee, juice, scrambled or fried eggs and toast.
  • Light (S/ 24.90): coffee, eggs, avocado and toast.
  • Amanecer Criollo (S/ 27.90): Americano and a pan con chicharrón, the classic Lima breakfast sandwich.

The Light and the American breakfast are the most ordered. On Saturdays, from 9 a.m., brunch is the plan. For the Peruvian options, read our guide to a Peruvian breakfast in Lima.

Egg and ham croissant at Wasi Café, San Isidro, Lima
Peruvian tamal at Wasi Café, San Isidro, Lima

secciones.html: Monday to Saturday, from 12 to 4 p.m., there are lunch combos with a main dish, Andean potatoes and a drink of your choice: the chicken fillet combo (S/ 25.90), our most ordered, and steak, pork chop, breaded cutlet, chicken breast or burger combos at S/ 29.90. There are also sandwiches, burgers and salads all day.

fotos.alt: Chicken fillet sandwich at Wasi Café, San Isidro, Lima
Wasi burger at Wasi Café, San Isidro, Lima
Caesar salad at Wasi Café, San Isidro, Lima

secciones.html:
• Chicha morada (S/ 13.90): a traditional drink made from purple corn.
  • Lúcuma: a Peruvian fruit that tastes a bit like caramel. Try it as a milkshake (S/ 17.90) or a frozen drink.
  • Pisco sour (S/ 17.90): Peru's signature cocktail, with pisco, lime, syrup and egg white.
  • Affogato with pisco (S/ 18.90): espresso over ice cream with half an ounce of pisco, a house recipe.

More in our guide to Peruvian drinks to try in Lima.

Lúcuma milkshake at Wasi Café, San Isidro, Lima

secciones.html:
• Payments: cash, credit and debit cards, and the local apps Yape and Plin.
  • WiFi: free for customers.
  • Pets: dogs are welcome.
  • Ordering: scan the QR code on your table to see the menu with photos and order directly; you can also ask for the bill from your phone.
  • Take away: everything on the menu can be ordered to go.
  • Reservations: from our website; we confirm by WhatsApp.

Wasi Café is at Luis Felipe Villarán 904, San Isidro, Lima, a short walk from Javier Prado Avenue, close to El Olivar park and the financial district. We are open Monday to Friday from 8:00 a.m. to 9:00 p.m. and Saturday from 9:00 a.m. to 9:00 p.m.; closed on Sundays. Open it in Google Maps, or message us on WhatsApp at +51 908 724 496.

faq.p: Is Wasi Café open on Sundays?
faq.r: No. It is open Monday to Friday from 8:00 a.m. to 9:00 p.m. and Saturday from 9:00 a.m. to 9:00 p.m.
Yes, cash, credit and debit cards, Yape and Plin.

faq.p: Is the menu available in English?
faq.r: Yes, the online menu at wasicafe.com/carta has an English version.

tituloSeo: Peruvian breakfast in Lima: what to order | Wasi Café
h1: Peruvian breakfast in Lima: what to order, from pan con chicharrón to tamal
ogTitulo: What to order for a Peruvian breakfast in Lima
descripcion: A guide to Peruvian breakfast in Lima: pan con chicharrón, tamal, butifarra and chicha morada, with real prices at Wasi Café in San Isidro.
intro: A traditional Lima breakfast is not continental. It is fried pork in a crusty bread roll, a tamal wrapped in a banana leaf, sweet potato, a tangy onion relish called salsa criolla, and coffee. Here is what each one is and what it costs at Wasi Café, a specialty coffee shop in San Isidro, Lima.

secciones.html:
The king of the Lima breakfast: slices of slow-cooked, then fried pork (chicharrón) in a bread roll, with fried sweet potato and salsa criolla.

At Wasi it costs S/ 24.90, or S/ 27.90 in the «Amanecer Criollo» combo with an Americano.

fotos.alt: Pan con chicharrón at Wasi Café, San Isidro, Lima
Fried sweet potato at Wasi Café, San Isidro, Lima
Salsa criolla at Wasi Café, San Isidro, Lima

secciones.html:
A Peruvian tamal is corn dough with a filling, steamed in a banana leaf. In Lima it is eaten for breakfast with salsa criolla, often inside a pan francés, the local bread roll.

Our Tamal Criollo (S/ 16.90) comes with salsa criolla in pan francés. The Desayuno Tamalero (S/ 21.90) adds a coffee.

fotos.alt: Tamal criollo at Wasi Café, San Isidro, Lima

secciones.html: The butifarra (S/ 20.90) is a sandwich of jamón del país, a Peruvian-style cooked ham, with salsa criolla. Lighter than the chicharrón and just as local. If you want beef, try the sándwich de asado (S/ 24.90), with roast beef in artisan bread.

fotos.alt: Butifarra at Wasi Café, San Isidro, Lima
Roast beef sandwich at Wasi Café, San Isidro, Lima

secciones.html:
If you want the whole experience, the Tradición Wasi (S/ 78.90) is made for sharing. It includes:

  • 2 coffees and 2 fresh juices (papaya or pineapple).
  • 250 g of chicharrón and a chicken tamal.
  • 100 g of salchicha huachana, a spiced sausage from the north of Lima, and 4 bread rolls.
  • Fried sweet potato and salsa criolla.

It is what a Saturday breakfast looks like in many Lima homes.

• Coffee: an Americano (S/ 9.00) or a café con leche (S/ 11.00). Ours is Peruvian specialty coffee from Cusco, Cajamarca, Junín, Amazonas and San Martín.
  • Fresh juice: papaya (S/ 12.90) is our most ordered juice, followed by the mixed juice and pineapple.
  • Chicha morada (S/ 13.90): the purple corn drink pairs well with chicharrón.

fotos.alt: Americano at Wasi Café, San Isidro, Lima
Papaya juice at Wasi Café, San Isidro, Lima
Chicha morada at Wasi Café, San Isidro, Lima

secciones.html:
No problem. These are breakfast options without chicharrón, all with coffee included:

  • Pollo Wasi (S/ 25.90): coffee, juice and a chicken sandwich.
  • Light (S/ 24.90): coffee, eggs (boiled, scrambled or fried), avocado and toast.
  • Dúo Café (S/ 19.90): coffee and a classic ham and cheese sandwich, the quickest option.

Omelettes start at S/ 18.50, and the full omelette with ham, cheese, bacon, tomato and pepper costs S/ 24.90.

In Lima, pan con chicharrón is often a Sunday tradition, but Wasi Café is closed on Sundays. Come Monday to Friday from 8 a.m., or on Saturday from 9 a.m. for a long, unhurried breakfast.

If you prefer something more familiar, there are omelettes, eggs and toast too: see our visitor's guide to Wasi Café.

Wasi Café is at Luis Felipe Villarán 904, San Isidro, Lima, a short walk from Javier Prado Avenue, close to El Olivar park and the financial district. We are open Monday to Friday from 8:00 a.m. to 9:00 p.m. and Saturday from 9:00 a.m. to 9:00 p.m.; closed on Sundays. Everything can be ordered to go. Open it in Google Maps, or message us on WhatsApp at +51 908 724 496.

faq.p: What is a typical breakfast in Lima?
faq.r: Pan con chicharrón, tamal with salsa criolla, butifarra, fried sweet potato and coffee are the classics.

faq.p: How much is pan con chicharrón at Wasi Café?
faq.r: The chicharrón sandwich costs S/ 24.90, or S/ 27.90 with an Americano.

faq.p: Can I have a Peruvian breakfast on Sunday at Wasi Café?
faq.r: No, Wasi Café is closed on Sundays. On Saturdays it opens at 9:00 a.m.

tituloSeo: Peruvian drinks to try in Lima: chicha, lúcuma, pisco sour
h1: Peruvian drinks to try in Lima: chicha morada, lúcuma, pisco sour and specialty coffee
tituloCorto: Peruvian drinks to try in Lima
ogTitulo: Peruvian drinks you have to try in Lima
descripcion: Peruvian drinks to try in Lima: chicha morada, lúcuma and passion fruit, pisco sour and Peruvian specialty coffee, with prices at Wasi Café, San Isidro.
intro: Peru has drinks you won't find anywhere else: a purple corn drink, fruits with no English name, and a national cocktail. This is a short guide to what to try, and where to try it in San Isidro: Wasi Café, a specialty coffee shop on Luis Felipe Villarán 904. All prices are in Peruvian soles.

secciones.html: The most Peruvian of soft drinks: purple corn boiled with fruit and spices, served cold. It is sweet, a little spiced, and goes with almost any meal. At Wasi a glass costs S/ 13.90, and there is also a chicha morada frozen blended with ice (S/ 18.90).

fotos.alt: Chicha morada at Wasi Café, San Isidro, Lima
Chicha morada frozen at Wasi Café, San Isidro, Lima

secciones.html: Lúcuma is an Andean fruit with dry, orange flesh and a flavour somewhere between caramel and sweet potato. It is hard to find fresh outside Peru, so try it here. We serve it as a milkshake (S/ 17.90) and as a frozen (S/ 19.90).

fotos.alt: Lúcuma milkshake at Wasi Café, San Isidro, Lima
Lúcuma frozen at Wasi Café, San Isidro, Lima

secciones.html: Maracuyá (passion fruit) is everywhere in Lima. Try the maracuyá drink (S/ 11.90) or the maracuyá frozen (S/ 16.90). Fresh juices are a breakfast staple: papaya is our most ordered, and there is mango, pineapple, orange and strawberry too, from S/ 12.90. The Jugo Especial (S/ 18.90) mixes papaya, pineapple, strawberry, banana and algarrobina, a carob syrup.

fotos.alt: Passion fruit drink at Wasi Café, San Isidro, Lima
Papaya juice at Wasi Café, San Isidro, Lima
Jugo especial at Wasi Café, San Isidro, Lima

secciones.html: Pisco is a Peruvian grape brandy, and the pisco sour is the country's signature cocktail: pisco, lime, syrup and egg white, shaken until it foams. At Wasi it costs S/ 17.90. If you'd rather have it with coffee, the Affogato Wasi + Pisco (S/ 18.90) pours espresso over vanilla ice cream with half an ounce of pisco.

fotos.alt: Pisco sour at Wasi Café, San Isidro, Lima
Affogato with pisco at Wasi Café, San Isidro, Lima

secciones.html: Peru is one of the world's coffee producers, and its high-altitude beans are what we serve: 100% Peruvian specialty coffee from Cusco, Cajamarca, Junín, Amazonas and San Martín. An espresso (S/ 9.00) or a filter coffee (S/ 8.00) are the best way to taste it. If you take milk, the cappuccino is our most popular coffee after the Americano.

fotos.alt: Espresso at Wasi Café, San Isidro, Lima
Filter coffee at Wasi Café, San Isidro, Lima

secciones.html: Lima's summer, from December to April, calls for cold drinks. With our Peruvian coffee you can have an iced coffee (S/ 14.90), an iced latte (S/ 15.90) or a frappé in medium or large, from S/ 15.90. The mocha frappé is the most ordered.

After a meal, many people in Lima drink an herbal infusion instead of coffee. Each costs S/ 11.00: chamomile (manzanilla), anise (anís), lemon verbena (hierba luisa), mint (hierba buena), black tea and iced hibiscus (jamaica). We also have the tepuchino, a house creation: tea topped with milk foam, like a cappuccino without coffee.

fotos.alt: Lemon verbena tea at Wasi Café, San Isidro, Lima
Tepuchino at Wasi Café, San Isidro, Lima

secciones.html: Wasi Café is at Luis Felipe Villarán 904, San Isidro, Lima, a short walk from Javier Prado Avenue, close to El Olivar park and the financial district. We are open Monday to Friday from 8:00 a.m. to 9:00 p.m. and Saturday from 9:00 a.m. to 9:00 p.m.; closed on Sundays. Payments by cash, card, Yape or Plin. Open it in Google Maps, or message us on WhatsApp at +51 908 724 496.

faq.r: A traditional Peruvian drink made from purple corn, served cold. At Wasi Café it costs S/ 13.90.
Like a mix of caramel and sweet potato. Try it as a milkshake or a frozen drink.

faq.p: Where can I try a pisco sour in San Isidro?
faq.r: At Wasi Café, Luis Felipe Villarán 904, for S/ 17.90, until 9 p.m. Monday to Saturday.
